capabilities: Collapse the sidebar by clicking note content
Expand the sidebar by clicking the blank area of the left ribbon
Expand the sidebar by clicking the note title
Expand the sidebar by clicking near the left or right editor edge
Set the edge click distance in pixels
problem: Sidebars take up screen space while reading or writing, and hiding them normally takes a command or hotkey instead of a click.
summary: Plugin that collapses the sidebars when you click the note content and can expand them again by clicking the ribbon, title or editor edges.
